authors.bio: Christopher Lennon is a second-generation broadcaster, who has worked in the broadcasting industry for over 25 years. He is Harris Corporation's Director of Integration and Standards, part of the CTO Group. Lennon is Chair of several activities within SMPTE. He is also active in a wide array of standards development organizations across the broadcast, cable, digital signage, and internet protocol television (IPTV). He was a recipient of SMPTE's 2008 Society Citation Award.
authors.name: Christopher Lennon

authors.bio: Karen Broome is Manager, Metadata Standards, at Sony Pictures Entertainment. She is Chair of SMPTE's 30.10 Metadata Definition working group, which manages the registration of SMPTE metadata. She also serves as secretary of the 31 FS Files and Structures technical committee.
authors.name: Karen Broome

authors.bio: Harold S. Geller is Managing Director, Ad-ID LLC, and SVP, Digital Initiatives for the American Association of Advertising Agencies (4A's). As of October 2007, Ad-ID is the only advertising coding-system supported and authorized by the 4A's and the Association Of National Advertisers (ANA).
authors.name: Harold Geller

authors.bio: Régis Flad is Director Digital Media Technologies of ISAN International Agency, the Registration Authority mandated by ISO to implement and run the ISAN standard. Flad joined ISAN-IA in 2006 where he focuses on standards, ISAN dissemination and implementation in audiovisual databases, and media solutions.
authors.name: Régis Flad
